subject: Proposal CPI/2026/00512 — Underwriting Decision
body:
Proposal Number: CPI/2026/00512
Insured: Suryodaya Petrochem Industries Pvt. Ltd.
Broker: Vikram Risk & Insurance Advisors LLP

Dear Vikram Risk & Insurance Advisors LLP,

After underwriting review, Proposal CPI/2026/00512 for Suryodaya Petrochem Industries Pvt. Ltd. has not been approved.
Reason: Excessive inherent material hazards and risk without adequate mitigation, high CAT exposure, and poor loss history make this an unacceptable risk.

Regards,
Underwriting Team, Commercial Property Division
reason: Excessive inherent material hazards and risk without adequate mitigation, high CAT exposure, and poor loss history make this an unacceptable risk.
